column1: # Data Source: IAEA/WMO Global Network of Isotopes in Precipitation (GNIP)
# - Large atmospheric peak from thermonuclear weapons testing (1960s)
# - Concentrations have been declining exponentially since peak
# - Natural production from cosmic ray interactions
# - Excellent tracer for modern groundwater (< 60 years old)
# Extrapolation: Not recommended beyond data range
